review.notes: Original design delivery preceded implementation. Four review tests existed before this machine-readable record; this seal does not claim prior committed test design or satisfy PR-history ordering. No commits/releases in this task yet. Other cases recorded before test implementation; mobile UI and production causal outcomes unverified. Continuation review before HQ workflow test: bilingual seed teaches consult before goal construction, quality admission without empty-query capture, scoped evidence and bounded review on existing distill, and honest advisory budget/receipts. Version/reseed regression is covered by existing HQ tests; no active home is reseeded. User no-commit constraint still overrides design-first commit convention; history gate remains unverified. Follow-up review before vault publication test: direct truncating export could lose the editor baseline on interruption; require atomic same-directory publication, old open snapshot preservation, 0600 new inode, and read-only destination refusal. Existing raw-writer guard must remain unchanged.
